title: FlowerPot D x OA
description: A plant stand that pairs a bent wood base with a cast pot. It was developed from dimensioned drawings into a built piece, photographed in place.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: A bent wood base that lifts and cradles the pot, turning a houseplant into a piece of furniture.

brief.label: Market
brief.text: Indoor planters are the faster-growing side of a $10B market.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Planter makers such as Elho, Scheurich and HC Companies.

charts.title: Pots and planters market by setting, 2025
charts.caption: Indoor planters are growing faster and are expected to reach about 42% of revenue by 2035.
